note: 形象设定来自 web 公开资料调研（水豚噜噜 / Capylulu，版权方铁罐(北京)文化传媒有限公司）。提示词用于 AI 生成风格近似的原创绘制，不是官方素材，也没有复制任何网络成品图；逐张按同名覆盖 frame-<id>.png 即可替换。
stylePrefix: chibi cartoon capybara mascot Lulu, round plump mango-yellow body, short limbs, small round ears, large black dot eyes, wide flat muzzle, gentle toothy grin, a small orange with green leaf on top of head, warm pale yellow-brown fur, calm relaxed unhurried expression, soft flat 2D vector illustration, clean even brown outlines, pastel warm palette, full body, centered, plain white background, single character, no text, no watermark, no shadow, consistent mascot design
negativePrompt: photorealistic, 3d render, realistic fur texture, watermark, text, logo, signature, multiple characters, extra limbs, human body, clothing, busy background, gradient background, cast shadow on ground, harsh highlights, deformed face, cropped body, chibi human
promptRule: 完整提示词 = stylePrefix + ', ' + 该帧 prompt + ；negativePrompt 单独作为负向提示词。所有帧必须使用完全相同的 stylePrefix。

priority.P0: 核心状态 15 张，已全部由 AI 生成并安装（见 assetStatus）
priority.P1: 第二批：日常互动与情绪表达

assetStatus.workflow: web 形象调研 → ImageGen 生成核心帧 → process_ai_assets.py 抠白底/对齐锚点 → fill_remaining.py 语义复用补齐 → install_assets.py 安装并同步双端
